name: Islamabad Capital Territory

sources.name: Pakistan Bureau of Statistics, 7th Population and Housing Census 2023, Table 10: population by nationality, age group, sex and rural/urban
sources.license: Pakistan Bureau of Statistics, free reuse with attribution

ethnicity_note: Nationality, not ethnicity: Census 2023 Table 10 counts everyone enumerated by nationality -- Pakistani, Afghani, Bangali (shown as Bangladeshi), Chinese and others -- and the Bureau's own National Census Report says the question "can be called and understood as citizenship, or more generally as subject or belonging to a sovereign state, and not as ethnicity". The census asks no ethnicity question. 56,045 of the 2,283,244 people counted here are not Pakistani nationals.
